description: For those with exceptional leadership and teamwork skills.
description2:
We're looking for a Restaurant Manager to join our team! If you're into managing departments, staffing, or helping bring big ideas to life — we want you on board.

Responsibilities:
- Assisting with task management
- Helping with leading the Junior Management team and ensuring smooth operations
- Implementing new systems / features
-  Great communication + leadership skills
- Able to meet deadlines
- Passion for Roblox Communities
- Basic experience with Google Workspace and Office
